notes: Active limits 2/4/8, three balanced-order repeats each at 5 sessions/s; short local comparison, not capacity.
Only maxActive varies. Batch=2, worker=1000ms, polling=5000ms, hold=500ms; per-run p95 ranges/medians are not pooled p95.
Each stage uses a fresh 20-seat fixture; all fixtures prepared in the same disposable DB.
Hold/release only. No Checkout, real PG, KOPIS or browser traffic.
Arrival rate is sessions/s, not HTTP RPS. Poll interval 5s; active tickets are held through release/leave.
DB counter windows are sampled, include drain/collector traffic and are not query-specific.
Explicit --debug=false and package logger overrides are requested; inspect private runtime logs for effective logging before interpreting latency.

runs.scope: short local virtual 20-seat admission exploration; not capacity or production performance

observation.counterScope: first-to-last sampled counter window, includes drain and collector SQL; not query attribution or whole-run delta
